subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He said that it would be fun if I could join.

options.text: He said, "It will have been fun if I had joined."
He said, "It will have been fun if I could have joined."
He said, "It will be fun if you can join."
He said, "It will have been fun if you had joined."

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that it would be fun if I could join.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"it would be fun if I could" becomes "it will be fun if you can"**
 
 
• Future conditional "it would be" is converted to "it will be" to match direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Modal verb "could" is changed to "can" to match the direct speech context.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "It" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said, "It will be fun if you can join.""*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "It will have been fun if I had joined." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense and context, creating an incorrect conditional past perfect scenario.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "It will have been fun if I could have joined." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense and modal verbs, changing the meaning to an unreal past condition.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "It will have been fun if you had joined." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense and context, creating an incorrect conditional past perfect scenario.
 
 

``
